factorConvention: Apply visualSteerFactor to normalized steering weight [-1,+1], not raw physics steer. steer_left=-20deg around the reported tilted Three wheelAxis; physics positive steer means left. Actor hands solved for same motion.
localOrigin: Centre of rim. Driver-facing normal is opposite wheelAxis; column extends along wheelAxis toward dashboard. Place at wheelCenter in driver coordinate space, then apply same driver scale and translation.
columnDirection: Fixed authored curved support runs down from the rim and back to the chassis between the operator legs. Only wheel_rotor moves; wheel tilt -28.648deg.
limit: Industrial work-machine wheel, authored interpretation; not claimed exact AUSA model/part.
